Kirtipur — the exam centre

Five kilometres southwest of Kathmandu, the ancient town of Kirtipur has been the examination centre for Tribhuvan University since its founding. The Dean's Office notice (2083/07/28) names it plainly: your papers are written here.

What the hall looks like

Rows of desks. The same answer booklet for every paper. The invigilator's bell. Your admit card on the corner. The clock on the wall — the only timepiece allowed. This is where the ten days happen.
